segments.name: Virtual Content Production
segments.description: Operates live-streaming e-commerce on TikTok in the United States and holds Bitcoin as a long-term digital asset reserve.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as a single segment and has one operating and reportable segment, the Virtual Content Production.

revenueModel.text: The company currently generates no revenue from core operations and intends to earn sales from TikTok users purchasing products featured in its live streams.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company does not currently generate revenues from its core business operations, and there is no guarantee that the Company will generate any revenues in the future.

changes.text: In 2022, the Company terminated the VIE agreements with Wuge and stopped consolidating it.
changes.evidence: On September 28, 2022, Makesi WFOE entered into a termination agreement with Wuge and the shareholders of Wuge to terminate the VIE Agreements and to cancel the shares previously issued to the shareholders of Wuge.

changes.text: In 2023, the Company sold TMSR HK (ending the Yuan Ma VIE) and terminated the Highlight Media VIE.
changes.evidence: On September 26, 2023, Highlight WFOE entered into a termination agreement with Highlight Media and the shareholders of Highlight Media to terminate the VIE Agreements and sold the interest in the VIE Agreements for a purchase price of $100,000.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired Pallas Capital Holding Ltd, which holds Bitcoin as a long-term reserve.
changes.evidence: On September 29, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of Pallas Capital Holding Ltd, a British Virgin Islands company ("Pallas"), pursuant to a Share Exchange Agreement dated September 10, 2025.
